scope: Unanswered choice and number questions reveal explanations through the primary control and record seen.
Entered answers retain grading; invalid input clears when edited or explanation is opened.
The warm palette uses a more vivid terracotta while preserving mathematical correspondence colors and layout.
Read the complete Practice.tsx and its baseline diff; only this application file differs from the stated baseline.
Read the unchanged ProgressProvider add/persist flow and progress.ts mergeAttempts/historyFor/stateFor logic to trace attribution.

Choice with no selection and number with empty or whitespace-only input use the clearly labelled explanation action, reveal the existing worked answer, and finalize an outcome of seen rather than independent, assisted or retry.

Number-form Enter invokes the same check function and hence the same empty-input explanation branch. Nonempty malformed number input still fails validation without revealing or recording a new graded result.
Input edits and explicit reveal clear validation messages; valid answered choice/number still use the existing correct/retry and hint/help-dependent independent/assisted logic.

Existing hint preview and final reveal reuse the same attemptId. recorded.current prevents repeated final records; previewed.current and recorded.current prevent repeated previews; historyFor retains reviewOf attribution and seen remains due for review.
Revealed inputs are disabled. The existing ExampleSteps continuation is enabled by the seen outcome, while the explanation remains stepwise or fully readable.
Paper-answer hasAnswer remains true, retaining both the paper-work comparison/self-assessment path and direct seen-reveal path; completion labels and self/assisted attribution remain unchanged.
Question data, formulas, solutions, conditions, hints and supplementary review destinations are not modified.
limitations: Source-level independent review only: no browser interaction, screenshot/rendering, screen-reader, storage-failure or automated-test run was independently executed for this task. Main agent and assigned UI QA own those gates.
This review does not independently recalculate all unchanged mathematical exercises.
Approval is tied to the listed Practice.tsx SHA-256; later source edits require rechecking.
